name: Trade Party Identification Query 9
definition: Query of a trade party based on the identification.

LEI.name: LEI
LEI.definition: Legal entity identifier code used to recognise the counterparty of the reporting agent for the reported transaction.

CountryCode.name: Country Code
CountryCode.definition: Country where the registered office of the counterparty is located or country of residence in case that the counterparty is a natural person.

AnyBIC.name: Any BIC
AnyBIC.definition: Business identifier code used to identify the trade party.

ClientIdentification.name: Client Identification
ClientIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the client counterparty.

NotReported.name: Not Reported
NotReported.definition: Field can be queried for not reported value.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one of the 3 elements must be present.
